title: Rav Acha bar Nafcha
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Chullin 67b: Rav Mesharshiya son of Rav Acha bar Nafcha, according to the reading of the Rif, the Rosh and Dikdukei Soferim; in the Gemara texts Hyman uses the words “bar Nafcha” are missing.[^1]

notes.text: The digital Chullin 67b names Rav Mesharshiya son of Rav Acha without bar Nafcha. The readings ascribed to the Rif, Rosh and Dikdukei Soferim remain Hyman’s reports, not a fresh collation of those witnesses.
